known: I think this course is good
issue: 门 means 'door', not 'course' (course = 课/课程; 门 is only the MEASURE WORD as in 一门课). 这个门 reads as 'this door' — dishonest English gloss and wrong Mandarin.

known: she can study this course
issue: 学这个门 = 'study this door'. 门 does not mean 'course' and 这个门 is not a valid course reference (should be 这门课/这个课程). Gloss 'study this course' is dishonest; Mandarin is wrong.

known: she puts into the bag
issue: 在 (progressive) does not combine with the resultative/directional compound 放进...里, which denotes completion; '正在放进...里' is ungrammatical. Confusing/wrong Mandarin (should be 她在把…放进包里 or 她正把…往包里放).

target: 我觉得更多要学很重要
known: I think more to learn is important
issue: '更多要学' is not grammatical Mandarin for 'more to learn'. The string juxtaposes 更多 (more) + 要 (want/will) + 学 (study) without a valid structure; a native would say 还有更多要学的 or 要学的更多. As written it is confusing/ungrammatical. Same broken chunk recurs across several phrases.

target: 我知道更多要学不容易
known: I know more to learn is not easy
issue: Same ungrammatical '更多要学' chunk. '我知道更多要学不容易' does not parse as 'I know more to learn is not easy'; needs e.g. 我知道还有更多要学并不容易 / 要学的还有很多，不容易.

target: 因为更多要学，她很开心
known: Because more to learn, she is happy
issue: '因为更多要学，她很开心' is ungrammatical/confusing: '更多要学' is not a valid clause and 'because more to learn, she is happy' is itself broken English. Native: 因为还有很多要学，她很开心.

target: 如果更多要学，我要练习
known: If more to learn, I'm going to practise
issue: Two problems: '更多要学' ungrammatical, AND the frame is labelled 'neg' but the sentence is a conditional with 如果 (if), not a negation — frame/content mismatch. Also '我要练习' for 'I'm going to practise' is fine, but the protasis is broken.

known: I do not want more to learn
issue: '更多要学' ungrammatical here too. 'I do not want more to learn' → natural Mandarin would be 我不想再多学 / 我不想学更多. As written it is confusing.

known: I think she wants to study but sleep
issue: '却睡' is unnatural/confusing: 却 (yet/but) needs a fuller predicate, a bare 却睡 is not idiomatic ('却睡着了'/'却去睡觉了'). Combined with the gloss 'wants to study but sleep' (broken English), this is confusing Mandarin. Recurs across multiple 却睡 phrases.

target: 因为她累，她想回来，却睡
known: Because she is tired, she wants to come back but sleep
issue: Bare '却睡' is not idiomatic Mandarin (needs 却睡着了/却去睡了). Sentence reads as confusing/incomplete.

target: 如果你累，你想回来，却睡
known: If you are tired, you want to come back but sleep
issue: Same bare '却睡' problem — unnatural/incomplete predicate. Confusing Mandarin.

known: I do not want to come back but sleep
issue: '我不想回来，却睡' is contradictory and ungrammatical: 却睡 is incomplete, and 'do not want to come back but sleep' is broken English. Confusing.

known: I am studying but sleep
issue: '我在学，却睡' is unnatural — bare 却睡 incomplete; also semantically odd ('I am studying but sleep'). Native: 我在学习，却睡着了.

known: I think this is enough
issue: '我觉得这个足够' is stilted/incomplete: 足够 normally needs an object/complement or 了 (这个够了 / 这样就足够了). Bare 这个足够 is not idiomatic for 'this is enough'. Native: 我觉得这就够了 / 我觉得这样足够了.

known: I do not think it is enough
issue: Two issues: (1) 不足够 is unnatural; the natural negation is 不够 (我觉得不够了), 足够 is rarely negated as 不足够. (2) The English gloss 'I do not think it is enough' is a dishonest gloss — the Mandarin 我觉得它不足够 means 'I think it is not enough' (negation inside the clause), not 'I do not think it is enough' (negation of believing). Gloss mismatch.

known: She will ask people I don't know
issue: Ambiguous/odd Mandarin: 她会问我不认识的人 most naturally parses as 'She will ask ME, the person I don't know' or is genuinely ambiguous between 'ask people I don't know' and 'ask me, [a person who] doesn't know'. The intended relative-clause reading 'ask people (whom) I don't know' is strained because 问 + 我 reads as object 'ask me'. The English gloss 'She will ask people I don't know' does not reliably map. Confusing structure.

target: 我觉得你同意关于这个
known: I think you agree about this
issue: 同意关于这个 is a calque of English 'agree about this' and is wrong/confusing Mandarin. 同意 takes a direct object or clause (同意这个/同意这一点); it does not pair with 关于. Natural: 同意这个观点 or 对这个表示同意.

target: 你为什么不同意关于这个
known: why don't you agree about this
issue: Same 同意关于这个 calque error — ungrammatical collocation. Should be 不同意这个/这一点.

target: 如果你同意关于这个就告诉我
known: if you agree about this, tell me
issue: Same 同意关于这个 calque error. Natural: 如果你同意这个就告诉我.

target: 我们需要同意关于时间
known: we need to agree about the time
issue: 同意关于时间 is a calque of 'agree about the time' and is wrong Mandarin. Natural: 我们需要就时间达成一致 / 我们需要商定时间.

known: you can agree about this
issue: Same 同意关于这个 calque error. Natural: 你能同意这个吗 / 你可以接受这一点.

known: I need to make the arrangements today
issue: 做排 is broken/non-existent Mandarin. 'Make arrangements' = 安排 (ānpái) or 做安排; 排 alone does not mean 'arrangements'. Looks like a faulty decomposition that peeled 排 off 安排, leaving a meaningless verb-object string a learner cannot reconstruct. Roman 'zuò pái' confirms the broken form.

known: she can help with the arrangements
issue: 'pái' (排) does not mean 'arrangements'. 安排 (ānpái) is the noun for 'arrangements'. Standalone 排 means 'to arrange/row/queue' and is not a noun for 'the arrangements' — '她能帮排' reads as 'she can help arrange/queue' and is confusing/wrong as a rendering of 'she can help with the arrangements'.

known: I think the arrangements are good
issue: Same lego defect: 排 cannot stand for the noun 'the arrangements'. '我觉得排很好' is not natural Mandarin for 'I think the arrangements are good'; should use 安排. Confusing.

known: I want to know because of the arrangements
issue: '因为排' is broken Mandarin — 排 alone is not 'the arrangements' and a bare '因为排' is ungrammatical/confusing. Needs 安排 and 因为 typically pairs with 所以 or restructuring.

known: I don't know about the arrangements
issue: '我不知道排' does not mean 'I don't know about the arrangements'; 排 is not the noun and 不知道 + bare 排 is confusing. Would need 我不知道安排 / 我不清楚安排。

target: 我觉得这是不同的完全方式
known: I think this is a different completely way
issue: Word order is wrong: adverb 完全 must precede 不同 (完全不同的方式 = 'a completely different way'). '不同的完全方式' is ungrammatical/confusing Mandarin and the gloss 'different completely way' is itself broken English mirroring the broken target.

target: 我想学，但是用新的完全方式
known: I want to learn, but in a new completely way
issue: '新的完全方式' is unnatural/confusing — 完全 cannot post-modify like this. Should be 完全新的方式 or just 全新的方式. As written it is wrong Mandarin.

target: 她能用不同的完全方式说
known: she can speak in a different completely way
issue: Same defect: 完全 misplaced — must be 完全不同的方式 ('a completely different way'). '不同的完全方式' is ungrammatical/confusing.

target: 我不想要这个完全方式
known: I don't want this completely way
issue: '这个完全方式' is not natural Mandarin; 完全 cannot directly modify 方式 as an attributive adjective here. Confusing rendering of 'this completely way' (the English is also broken).

target: 你为什么想要不同的完全方式
known: why do you want a different completely way
issue: Same misplacement: should be 完全不同的方式 ('a completely different way'). '不同的完全方式' is ungrammatical Mandarin.

known: she is not outside
issue: '在外' alone is unnatural/wrong for 'outside (a location)'. Standard Mandarin is 在外面/在外边. Bare 在外 means 'away from home/abroad' (adverbial), not 'is not outside'. Confusing Mandarin.

known: why is she outside now
issue: Same 在外 problem: needs 在外面 for 'be outside'. Bare 在外 reads as 'away from home', mismatching gloss 'is she outside'.

known: I think she is outside
issue: Same 在外 issue; should be 在外面 for 'she is outside'.

known: I need to go outside
issue: '去外' is ungrammatical for 'go outside'. Must be 去外面. 外 cannot stand alone as the object of 去 here.

known: she didn't go around
issue: 转 (zhuǎn) does not mean 'go around'. It means 'turn/rotate'. For 'go around' use 绕/转圈. Gloss is misleading/wrong.

known: why does she want to go around
issue: Same: 转 = turn, not 'go around'. Dishonest gloss.

known: she can go around
issue: 转 = turn, not 'go around'; also bare 会转 is bland but the gloss mismatch is the issue.

known: we need to go around
issue: 转 = turn/transfer, not 'go around'. Gloss mismatch.

known: I am able to go around
issue: 'wǒ néng zhuǎn' means 'I can turn/rotate', not 'I am able to go around'. 转 means turn, not go around. Dishonest gloss / wrong Mandarin for the intended meaning.

known: she doesn't want to sell off that vehicle
issue: 那辆 is incomplete — measure word 辆 requires a noun (那辆车). '那辆' alone meaning 'that vehicle' is ungrammatical/confusing; you cannot end on a bare measure word here.

target: 我们为什么想卖掉那辆
known: why do we want to sell off that vehicle
issue: 那辆 is a dangling measure word with no noun; '那辆' for 'that vehicle' is ungrammatical. Needs 那辆车 or similar.

known: she doesn't know the arrangements
issue: 排 alone does not mean 'the arrangements'. 排 = 'to arrange/row'; 'arrangements' is 安排. '她不知道排' is not meaningful Mandarin for the gloss — confusing/wrong.

target: 我们为什么需要改变排
known: why do we need to change the arrangements
issue: 排 does not mean 'the arrangements' (that is 安排). '改变排' is not idiomatic/meaningful; wrong word for arrangements.

target: 我觉得我们应该完成排
known: I think we should finish the arrangements
issue: 排 ≠ 'arrangements' (安排). '完成排' is ungrammatical/confusing. Also 完成 (finish) + bare 排 does not parse.

target: 如果你能改变排就好了
known: if you can change the arrangements that would be good
issue: 排 ≠ 'arrangements' (安排); '改变排' is not meaningful Mandarin for the gloss.

known: she can change the arrangements
issue: 排 ≠ 'arrangements' (安排); '改变排' is not meaningful Mandarin for the gloss.

target: 我觉得我们需要增加多一点
known: I think we need to add a little more
issue: "增加多一点" is malformed Mandarin. "增加"(increase) clashes with "多一点"(a bit more) producing a redundant/ungrammatical construction. Natural: "我觉得我们需要多加一点" or "再多加一点". The current target is confusing/wrong, not merely stilted.

known: I know that part
issue: Measure word error. "部" cannot mean "part" as a generic noun here. "that part" = "那部分" (nà bùfen). "那部" reads as a fragment/measure-word for films or machines, so it is wrong/confusing for the gloss "I know that part". Roman "nà bù" also mismatches.

known: because this part is important
issue: Same defect: "这部" does not mean "this part". Should be "这部分" (zhè bùfen). As written it is an incomplete measure-word phrase, wrong for the gloss "this part is important".

known: I think I want to learn new things
issue: "新事" is not idiomatic for "new things". Natural Mandarin is "新事物" or "新东西". "学新事" is wrong/confusing; "学习新东西"/"学新事物" expected.

known: because I want to learn new things
issue: Same "新事" defect: not idiomatic Mandarin for "new things". Should be "新东西"/"新事物".

target: 她从今天早上在找工作
known: she is looking for work since this morning
issue: "从今天早上...在找" is ungrammatical for "since this morning". Mandarin marks duration-since with "从...就一直" → "她从今天早上就一直在找工作". Bare "从...在" is wrong/confusing; the "since" durative reading is not licensed.

target: 我很累，因为我从今天早上在学习
known: I am tired because I am studying since this morning
issue: Same "从今天早上...在学习" defect: missing "就一直". Correct: "从今天早上就一直在学习". As written the "since this morning" meaning is not properly expressed.

known: I need to wait since this morning
issue: "我从今天早上需要等" is ungrammatical for "I need to wait since this morning". "从..." needs a durative continuation (就一直在等 / 一直得等). As written it is confusing/wrong word order.

target: 如果你从今天早上在工作，你应该很累
known: if you are working since this morning, you should be tired
issue: Same "从今天早上...在工作" defect: needs "就一直" → "如果你从今天早上就一直在工作". Bare "从...在" does not convey "since this morning"; wrong/confusing.

target: 我知道你短时间里做了这么多
known: I know you do so much in short time
issue: Unnatural/confusing: '短时间里' needs the demonstrative '这么' (这么短时间内/在这么短的时间里) to mean 'in such a short time'. Bare '短时间里做了这么多' is awkward and the gloss 'in short time' is itself broken English, signaling the seed is malformed.

target: 为什么她短时间里做了这么多
known: Why did she do so much in short time
issue: Same defect: '短时间里' is unnatural without 这么/在...里 framing. Natural would be '为什么她在这么短的时间里做了这么多'. Confusing as written.

target: 我觉得我们应该等结束。
known: I think we should wait to finish.
issue: '等结束' is confusing/broken: 等 needs an object or 等到 to mean 'wait until it finishes'. '等结束' reads as 'wait [for] finishing' and is unnatural. Natural: '等它结束/等到结束'. The English 'wait to finish' is also ambiguous.

known: I need to wait to finish.
issue: Same '等结束' problem — needs 等到/等它结束. Unnatural as standalone Mandarin.

known: I can wait to finish.
issue: Same '等结束' issue; additionally 能 here is less natural than 可以 for 'I can wait'. Core defect is '等结束'.

known: If you want, I will wait to finish.
issue: Same '等结束' defect; otherwise the if-frame is fine.

known: Tomorrow I will wait to finish.
issue: Same '等结束' defect.

target: 我觉得这个服务很重要。
known: I think this service is important.
issue: Measure-word/sense mismatch: '这个服务' with 服务 as a noun is fine in business contexts, but glossing 'this service is important' with 服务=fúwù as the abstract activity 'serving' (per the prior '服务社区' frame) conflates verb-服务 and count-noun-服务. Mild but the demonstrative 这个 forces a countable reading inconsistent with the 'serve the community' sense; borderline confusing.
